_README: A DIRECTORY LISTING, not block metadata. Static hosting (GitHub Pages) cannot
list a folder, so the page has to be told which class files exist.
It carries filenames and NOTHING ELSE. Blocks are still grouped only by the
`Date:` inside each file - a manifest that also claimed block membership could
disagree with the dates, and the dates are what heat sorts on.
WARNING: a file missing from this list is INVISIBLE TO HEAT. Add a class file,
add it here. The builder reports how many it loaded, so a gap is visible.
